items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce's webhooks component allows unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution due to improper output encoding.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows attackers to upload malicious files to the server, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw allows an attacker to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read and write access.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthorized Access
items.summary: This vulnerability allows a high-privileged attacker to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read access to resources.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extension
items.summary: Amasty released a security update for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
